About us

RZ GFID JOKI is run independently by one person: the founder, who is also the one doing all the work. Every order is handled by the same person who answers your messages.

Since 2023 we have helped players with Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail and Zenless Zone Zero, from daily account care to full character builds.

Because it is a one-person service, our slots are limited, so some services may occasionally be marked as full. It also means you always talk directly to the person doing your order.

Order rules

A few simple rules so everything goes smoothly.

  • Payment is made first. Please send the proof of payment before we start.
  • You fill in the account form so we can verify your account details.
  • We ask you to send the verification code when we log in, so please keep your phone nearby.
  • Please do not log in to your account while we are working on it. If you need to, tell us first.
  • Some in-game materials may be used for account progression and other needs.

Questions

Not listed here? Send us a message.

How much does it cost?

See the price list above. The final price depends on your account's progress, and we confirm it in the DM before you pay.

How do you log in, and is it safe?

We log in the normal way, then ask you to send the verification code. Everything is played manually with no cheats or hacks. Third-party play can still go against a game's terms of service, so no one can promise zero risk. Message us if you have questions before ordering.

Can I order from outside Indonesia?

Yes. We serve players worldwide. International customers pay with PayPal, and you can message us in English.

How long does an order take?

It depends on the size of the job. We give you an estimate with your quote.

Can I see proof from other customers?

Yes. Our Instagram highlights show testimonials from past customers.

Will I get proof of progress?

Yes. We send you screenshots of the results while we work and when your order is done.

Ready to save your time?

Send us your game and goal. We will reply with a price and timeline.
